newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares push on, prices set to hold levels.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares push on, prices set to hold levels.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher in a quiet Wednesday market lacking much interest, with key blue chip Novo Nordisk in focus and dealers foreseeing another tame day ahead with prices holding their current levels.
"The bond market bolstered us throughout the day and Novo was in the limelight. Tomorrow looks like being quiet again with prices not progressing beyond today's levels," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.25 point higher at 127.76 in overall bourse turnover of 402 million crowns. The KFX December future rose 0.15 point to 128.40 with 1,211 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Novo posted 1996 first nine-month pre-tax profits 14 percent better than in the same period last year. The share soared to an all year record 1,016 crowns on the result, falling back later to close three crowns lower than at the opening at 992, hit by profit-taking.
Leading banks had a good day with Den Danske putting on two crowns to finish at 431 and rival Unidanmark edging three up to 272.
